text:
maria: quick thought — can we build a small 'pin wizard' to standardize release pins? interactive CLI that outputs a deploy-bot command + PR scaffold. goal: fewer ad-hoc pins and consistent rollback metadata.

kevin: love it. fields we'd need: service, target (image/tag), duration, min_instances, rollback_on_5xx, rollback_window, owner, smoke_check.

sophia: +1. devex wants a one-click template in the Console too. @devex-anna can we make CLI produce both a repo PR and a Console import file? :thumbsup:

devex-anna: yup. rough CLI UX: `rw pin create --service infra-api --image sha:abcd --duration 7d --rollback on-5xx --dry-run` -> prints PR branch + `deploy-bot pin apply --from-branch br/auto-pin-...`

liam: also add `--canary` to create canary pins (e.g., 10% traffic) and `--verify-hook` to attach smoke checks.

maria: also have it generate a small release_notes.md snippet we can paste into the release: reason, rollback criteria, owner, ops contact.

kevin: sketch of the YAML template I imagine:

```yaml
# pin-template generated by rw pin
service: infra-api
image: sha:abcd1234
duration: 7d
min_instances: 2
rollback_on_5xx: true
rollback_window: 15m
canary: {enabled: true, weight: 10}
owner: @maria
verify_hooks:
  - type: smoke
    path: /checks/smoke
    timeout: 60s
```

deploy-bot: Template registered: `pin-template-default-v1` (dry-run enabled). To apply: `/deploy pin apply --template pin-template-default-v1 --env prod`

maria: @deploy-bot can we validate `min_instances >= 2` for infra-api and run smoke checks after pin is applied?

deploy-bot: Validation rule added for `infra-api`: `min_instances >= 2`. Post-pin hook: trigger `/checks/smoke infra-api`. If hook fails, behavior depends on `rollback_on_5xx` and `--auto-rollback-pr` flag.

sophia: can we add `--auto-rollback-pr` to the CLI so if post-pin smoke fails it auto-opens a rollback PR and notifies the owner?

kevin: implementation note: store templates in repo `infra/deploy/templates/pins/*.yaml` and the CLI will create a branch `br/pin/<service>/<ts>` with the YAML + release_notes.md. Deploy-bot watches that path for auto-apply on approval.

liam: I'll take the CLI + PR scaffolding work. @kevin can you own deploy-bot validation/hooks + the Console import flow?

kevin: 👍 I'll wire the validation rules and add a `--dry-run` path that runs validations locally (no PR). Will open PR with unit tests and e2e stub for the bot. ETA: EOD tomorrow. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/2345

maria: perfect. can we pilot this during the next change window (Thu 22:00 PT)? want to test canary + auto-rollback behavior.

sophia: sounds good. tagging ops: @oncall-ops FYI — will coordinate watch.

maria: final checklist:
- liam: CLI + PR scaffolder + README snippet to docs/release-pinning.md
- kevin: deploy-bot validators + post-pin hooks + Console import
- devex-anna: Console UI flow + small copy for release notes
- run pilot Thu 22:00 PT

liam: taking it. I'll post a draft PR and a short demo video once branch is up.

kevin: opened draft PR and pushed tests. linking here when CI passes.

maria: thanks team. this should cut down the ad-hoc pin chaos. :rocket:
